PaceLine.underPace: Nicely paced — you're {amount} under an even month. Nothing to fix today.
PaceLine.overPace: A touch ahead of pace — about {amount} over an even month. Easy to ease back.
PaceLine.onPace: Right on an even pace for the month.

RecoveryPlan.overBy: You're over by {amount} this month. It happens — {daysLeft, plural, =0 {the reset} one {in # day the reset} other {in # days the reset}} wipes the slate clean.
RecoveryPlan.evenOutOffer: Want to even out? Start next month at {amount} and you're right back on track — or keep your usual cap and enjoy the fresh start.
RecoveryPlan.noMathNeeded: No math to do — the 1st starts you fresh at your full cap. Just ease off till then.

Household.title: Household
Household.inviteDescription: Share this code with your partner. When they enter it, their budget merges into yours and you share one cap.
Household.joinDescription: Got a code from someone? Enter it to share their cap. Your existing expenses come with you.
Household.invalidCode: That code is invalid, expired, or already used
Household.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts — try again in a bit
Household.hasOtherMembers: You'd need to leave your current household first — it has other members
Household.currencyMismatch: That household uses a different currency
Household.leaveDescription: You'll get a fresh household of your own with a full copy of everything logged so far — nothing is deleted or split. Everyone staying behind keeps their history exactly as it is too.
Household.leftHousehold: You've left — welcome to your new household
Household.onlyMember: You're the only member — there's nothing to leave

Settings.exportDescription: Download every expense you've ever logged as a CSV. Amounts are in minor units (e.g. cents) to avoid rounding errors.

PWA.installAndroid: Two taps for every expense, right from your home screen.
PWA.offline: You're offline. Anything you add will go through the moment you're back.
